name: Windows device journey
description: How a Windows device was enrolled, the groups that resulted, and everything that reaches it.
note: Starts from the device, not from Autopilot. Works for any enrolled device - Autopilot, co-managed, hybrid joined or manually enrolled. Where an Autopilot registration exists its group tag is shown, because dynamic rules commonly match on it. Groups come from real directory membership rather than from reading rules, because rule text can be written many ways and would not be definitive. Give two devices to compare them.

fields.label: Device name, serial number, Intune device ID, or Entra device ID, or two separated by a comma
fields.hint: One device to trace its journey, two to compare them. Any of name, serial number, Intune device ID or Entra device ID is accepted, and can be mixed. Names and serials are matched exactly; a GUID is tried as an Intune device ID first, then an Entra device ID.

fields.label: Also write an interactive HTML report
fields.hint: A single self-contained file showing how the device reached each group. Opens in any browser, works offline, no network needed.
